attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Cancelled
attributes.description: Detects cancellation of a Druva restore or recovery operation. Unexpected cancellation during incident response can inhibit recovery.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects cancellation of a Druva restore or recovery operation. Unexpected cancellation during incident response can inhibit recovery.

attributes.query:
(
  message:*recover*
  or message:*restore*
  or druva.event_type:*Recover*
  or druva.event_type:*Restore*
)
and (
  message:*cancel*
  or event.outcome:"Cancelled"
  or event.outcome:"Cancelled"
)
